placements.title: Grounding Diagnostics in Frontline Sequencing and Calibrated Inquiry
placements.frame: How should organizational diagnostics sequence frontline discovery prior to management engagement while calibrating question design and readout pathways?
placements.why: Captures the core methodological theme of structuring an organizational diagnostic around warehouse/frontline interviews before management, pruning ineffective maturity-scale instruments, and staging findings readouts from operations leadership to steering groups.
